review_notes.source_topology: The 5K fifth receiver at r74 is a printed isolated stub after 4M's attached L cap and white gap. The 4K/4L qualified J02 strap starts at the c113/r70 diamond and is isolated from +ZERO SHIFT, which ends at c110, and from the upper P3 stem, which ends at r65. The 3C.G08 c114 rail ends at r23; white rows24-25 separate it from the lower c114 rail driven by 5B.B07 at r26 into 4F.B07. The 2N r89 feedback and 7L r89 feedback remain separate; c182 r47 is an unjoined crossing of the 6K output rail.
